purpose: Publication-layout preview; all point estimates and interval endpoints are assumptions, not experimental observations.
interval_note: Manually reasoned, point-specific illustrative ranges. Not SD, SE, measured min/max, or empirical confidence intervals. No trial-level observations were generated.

interpretation.SR: Fraction reaching the goal before timeout without collision; budget compliance is a separate event in this draft.
interpretation.CR: Fraction with at least one collision under a common physical collision definition; do not redefine collisions using each method's inflated planning map.
interpretation.BVR: Fraction whose actual cumulative cost exceeds the assigned initial budget. Adopted draft protocol: a common scenario-specific reference budget for every method, z0/z_ref = 1. Budget violation does not terminate evaluation; absolute budgets require verification.
interpretation.Cost: Assumed all-trial mean cumulative execution cost through goal, physical collision, or timeout. This accounting convention was adopted for consistency on 2026-10-23, not recovered from logs. Exact running cost and units remain unresolved; no physical-unit or energy claim.
interpretation.intervals: Each interval is marginal; endpoints of different metrics are not a jointly sampled outcome and cannot be combined to infer joint feasibility.
interpretation.precision: One decimal is used to support reproducible layout only, not to claim measurement precision.
interpretation.width_rationale: Finite repeated evaluations at roughly a hundred trials per scenario motivate broad percentage-point scales only. No actual count, coverage probability, seed count, or estimator is inferred or verified. Individual endpoints are specified manually, never generated from this heuristic.
